Scan: scan a barcode to check our database and be brought to the whiskey associated with that barcode (label recognition in progress).

Search:
Search for your favorite whiskey, a new one you're thinking of buying or by category, brand or distillery. Defaults to the latest released whiskey

Auction Corner:
View all upcoming auctions in an easy to use calendar. Tap on a day to view live auctions or deadline days for each auction. Explore the auction houses we scrape and their details and top sold whiskey and explore any live auctions.

Valuations: Explore price history of whiskey looking at auction prices across a range of auction houses to give the most up to date and accurate prices for your bottles. Names are normalized for Irish Whiskey for easier search and analysis with Scotch and Bourbon soon to follow.

Vault: Access your vault for easy management of what you have in your collection, open, unopened or finished. Easily sorted to help you pick what to drink tonight. Get quick view of the total value (market driven) of your collection.

Wishlist: an easy way to keep track of those bottles you want to buy. 

Watchlist: the perfect way to keep an eye on hard to find bottles at auctions and see 6month vs 3 month prices to figure out the right time to buy
